title: L5R 4e resistance rules audit
scope: All 823 stable passages in sixteen sourcebooks, full-page confirmations and two independently selected whole chapters. This is not a cover-to-cover audit of sixteen books or a runtime test.

counting.rule: One mechanically distinct defensive rule, modifier, recovery procedure or non-roll protection. One ability can have several rows; general effect rolls and their shared Honour modifier are cross-referenced, not additive benefits.
counting.support: yes requires specific mechanical support; generic dice and reference text alone count no. differs can mean incorrect mechanical behavior or inaccurate reference text. sheet_mechanical_status distinguishes those cases.
counting.missing: Rows with sheet_mechanical_status no, including reference-only non-roll protections and four inaccurate reminders. This is not a bug count or the number of new resistance buttons to build.
counting.disagreements: Independent discrepancies; the Honour gate is one root cause affecting four rows. Design gaps, intentional scope exclusions and absent automation are not disagreements.
counting.trigger: One source/effect register entry counted once under its effect group. Combined effects stay composite. Different effects from one source may have separate entries. These records are not extra rule rows or a count of unique creatures/spells. The unusual flag is null when unassessed; the named roll is authoritative regardless of that flag.
counting.proposal: add means eligibility follows from the selected effect and established character/context state; ask means a player/GM must judge an extra circumstance. For non-roll protections, add/ask controls eligibility or reference presentation, never invents a roll.

design_observations: All fifteen named declarations exist. Fourteen match their printed conditional numerical effect; Honour has the confirmed Failure of Bushido scope discrepancy.
The current providers mostly expose declarations on broad roll kinds and rely on the player’s declaration. That is distinct from the proposed effect list filtered by the book’s named roll.

Fear should normally originate from a Willpower Trait Roll. Existing Honour, Hitomi and Reichin offers on Earth Ring rolls show that effect-sensitive filtering has not yet been built; they do not establish an Earth-based Fear rule.

Hotei has a justified dedicated button because its default defense is explicitly Contested Void; Tengoku has a justified Earth-only gate. Most modifiers name no standalone roll and should attach to the applicable effect’s roll.
The fifteen choices are not an exhaustive inventory of all resistance behavior already in the app: some penalties, disadvantage checks and broad automatic Trait/Skill bonuses live elsewhere.

owner_questions.question: Should the sheet keep Honour’s bonus against Fear? The owner-confirmed book reading bars it only against Intimidation and Temptation. Also preserve Brash’s explicitly granted Honour bonus when the provocation is not an Intimidation/Temptation roll.

Should the new design add Courage (+1k1 against Intimidation/Fear) and Honor (twice Honour instead of the ordinary contribution against Intimidation/Temptation)? Both are currently reminders only; the book reading remains settled.
Should the new design add its +5k0 against Intimidation, Temptation and Fear? The correct Technique text exists, but the benefit is absent from the preview.

Should the sheet apply or ask about resistance penalties as it does bonuses? Jurojin’s Curse is already mechanically implemented; Moto Curse, the Jigoku resistance penalty and Bad Health’s disease-specific reduction remain gaps.

Which optional and exceptional rules belong in the new menu: Counterspelling, Meditation-as-Etiquette, Void overload, Spirit Realms/Yumeji, Nothing corruption, returned spirits, nonhuman characters and unique artifacts? Nonhuman creation is intentionally unsupported today.
Should the new menu cover recovery from Dazed/Stunned and environmental dangers such as drowning or involuntary sleep?
Should Dazed action penalties apply to its Reaction-stage recovery roll? Keep this a GM ruling rather than silently reducing the recovery pool.

Include broad contested-Social/Skill/Trait bonuses when they apply to defence, or retain them in the ordinary roll engine? Do not double-apply bonuses such as Kaimetsu-Uo that the sheet already adds automatically.
Should external spells, curses and ally benefits become temporary tracked conditions, or player-confirmed choices? Yasuki Taskmaster also needs the commander’s Intimidation Rank.

Make Tetsuken’s twice-Glory replacement mutually exclusive with normal Honour/Paragon. Decide whether Miya Herald Rank 2’s Honour addition stacks with the ordinary Honour bonus against Intimidation/Temptation; the Technique does not double the whole roll. Do not automatically stack the overlapping Shadow Rank 1 and one-Brand penalties.
Cleansing the Body (Book of Void p188) first describes a target without Taint, but then says the bonus fails at one full Rank. Does a character at 0.1–0.9 qualify?
Imperial Scion Rank 2 (Emerald Empire p79) prints an opposed Courtier / Etiquette roll without a Trait. Which concrete Skill/Trait pairing should the sheet use if the GM adopts it?
Should the two distinct Whispering Flames spells be offered separately, labeled by book/element, to avoid borrowing the wrong resistance roll?
Shadow Rank1 adds a TN to a contested roll; how should this be represented without silently treating it as a dice penalty?

Core p273 describes a daily Earth check while the p276 exposure table lists Oni Mark weekly. Which cadence should the sheet present? Preserve both citations until ruled; the ordinary resistance TN is 15.

Bayushi Courtier Rank 1 (Core p127) divides the opponent’s Mental/Social Disadvantage points by three and calls for rounding without stating a direction. Which rounding convention should the sheet use? The five-Free-Raise cap and lack of a precise-knowledge requirement are settled.

Approve correcting the five other discrepancies listed above: Shosuro Blade, Dharma Technique, Apotheosis of Fire, Wholeness in All and Epilepsy recovery cadence? This audit has changed no application behavior.

method_notes: All numbered passages were reviewed without the resist-only filter. Cut entries and uncertain names were checked against full pages. Owner-settled Failure/Paragon/Yoritomo readings were carried forward.
Sourcebook prose was read transiently and paraphrased. No extracted sourcebook text is stored in these artifacts. Short entry names identify sources.
Printed pages follow the verified repository page map, not PDF viewer page numbers. Empty passage arrays identify discoveries outside the scanner’s extracted passage text.
All source comparisons are static, against the stated baseline. Search-only catalogue entries, Technique/spell reminders and general dice controls are distinguished from mechanical implementation.
Ordinary damage Reduction, armor, attacks, detection, lore, and unique NPC-only defenses are excluded unless they specify a relevant effect on player characters. Each excluded passage has a reason.

Broad modifiers are included when the examined rule explicitly covers a defensive contest, named resistance or relevant Ring/Trait. This is not an audit of every universal modifier such as wound penalties, Void spending, stance or all generic Skill bonuses.
The original passage matcher and numbering remain unchanged. The Core recall sample found five misses; the zero-yield Education chapter supplies little evidence about overall retrieval recall.
